caption: The four three-address instructions t1=a*b; t2=c*d; t3=t1+t2; x=t3 expand to six target instructions; the table shows the descriptors after each one. The final row shows R0 holds x and memory x holds t3; R1 is free.

spec.title: Descriptors: columns R0, R1, x
